narrative.overview: The experience combines a founder keynote, a live operating room, and premium optical glass. Mac and Sean are the human anchor that moves visitors from ambition to a concrete weekly system.
keyCharacteristics: Founder imagery at editorial scale with deliberate close crops.
Deep navy fields interrupted by cyan optics and controlled gold signals.
Scroll-led chapters with one horizontal system sequence and one cinematic registration close.

rules.name: The Gold Decision Rule
rules.body: Gold appears where the visitor commits, confirms, or reads an essential event fact.

rules.name: The Physical Glass Rule
rules.body: Every blurred surface must reveal, magnify, or separate something behind it.

dos: Do let one portrait, statement, or system interaction dominate each scene.
Do provide static and reduced-motion fallbacks for every authored motion.
donts: Don't invent testimonials, performance numbers, or approved event details.
Don't let motion hide core content or block registration.
